title: partner-cloud-marketplace-1on1-prep
content:
Context: prep notes for weekly partner sync + 1:1 with Liam (AWS lead) on marketplace listing progress and open blockers. Goal: align on next milestones for AWS, Azure, GCP listings; confirm owners for packaging/legal items; get firm dates for private offers and billing validation.

Agenda draft (30-40m):
- Quick status round (5m): each cloud rep (AWS/Liam, Azure/Sofia, GCP/Ravi) 1-2 bullets
- AWS Marketplace (10m): private offers timeline, technical packaging (SaaS vs AMI), billing/invoicing test plan
- Azure Marketplace (8m): pilot customer onboarding, marketplace certification gaps, legal redlines
- GCP Marketplace (5m): registry/OCI packaging questions, quota for billing test project
- Channel partner updates (5m): distribution partners pipeline, co-sell readiness
- Action items & owners (5m)

Notes / quick status (raw):
- AWS (Liam): Private offer paperwork with AWS sales is stalled pending finance sign-off. Need to confirm tax/legal PO template. Technical: SaaS integration mostly done, but we still need to validate token-exchange flow for SSO customers. Liam to run billing end-to-end test next week with dev account.
- Azure (Sofia): Certification portal flagged two items: logging retention & encryption-in-transit docs. Engineering has PRs but product/legal review needed. Azure wants marketing blurb and 1 pager by Nov 14.
- GCP (Ravi): Packaging direction: prefer container-based SaaS listing. Need to confirm image scanning compliance and service account scoping for Marketplace-managed projects. Ravi asked for a quota increase for test billing project (filed GCP-OPS ticket).
- Channel partners: initial outreach to 3 resellers (CloudScale, NorthStar, ByteLane). Two have NDA signed, one in negotiation. Need standard partner enablement deck + demo creds.

Open blockers / risks (personal notes):
- Finance/Legal (billing templates) blocking AWS private offer - escalated but no firm ETA. If >2 weeks, push AWS listing to soft launch without private offer and do manual procurement path for pilot customers.
- Compliance: image scanning & vulnerability CVE policy for GCP could delay by 1 week. Need to prioritize scanner integration (talk to infra-security).
- Marketing assets not ready for Azure deadline (Nov 14) - follow up with comms on Nov 6 to get early draft.

Decisions needed before next sync:
- Do we require private offers to GA in AWS? (impacts billing automation timeline)
- Mandatory docs for Azure certification: accept 30-day delay or allocate design resource to accelerate?

Action items (owner / due / notes):
- Liam O'Connor: run AWS billing E2E test in dev account, confirm invoice generation & tax handling by 2025-11-10. Link test logs to PRT-342. (HIGH)
- Sofia Martinez: deliver Azure marketing 1-pager draft by 2025-11-06 for review (MED)
- Ravi Kumar: follow up on GCP quota ticket and confirm image scanning approach with infra-security by 2025-11-09 (MED)
- Maya Patel (me): escalate finance/legal for AWS private offer template; request ETA and propose fallback plan by 2025-11-07 (HIGH)
- Product Eng: (assign to Alex Chen) finalize token-exchange SSO flow test cases and share runbook by 2025-11-08 (HIGH)
- Partnerships Ops: prepare partner enablement deck + demo creds for initial resellers by 2025-11-12 (LOW)

1:1 specific notes for Liam (pre-meeting):
- Ask: where finance sign-off stands, who is the direct contact? Can we bring legal into thread?
- Confirm: if private offer delayed, will AWS sales still list us as "available" for discovery? Need clarity for go-to-market messaging.
- Technical: verify SaaS vs AMI choice - are there customers who require AMI/bring-your-own-image? If so, what is scope?
- Rate-limit concern: AWS reported some throttling on control-plane during packaging; ask infra team to monitor (ticket infra-534).

Follow-up / Post-meeting template (to send after sync):
- Summary of decisions (1-2 bullets)
- Action items with owners and due dates (paste above list)
- Attached artifacts: marketplace checklist, billing test plan, certification gaps doc
- Request for weekly IL: "Please reply-all with any redlines or additional blockers by EOD two business days"

Scratchpad / one-off notes: 
- If Azure needs 30-day delay, propose soft-launch in EU region only to reduce regulatory reviews (check with privacy/legal).
- Consider building a short "marketplace FAQ" for sales to reduce back-and-forth on procurement path differences across clouds.
- Keep record of reseller NDA dates and expected ARR pipeline per partner (add small spreadsheet later).

Links / tickets to reference during meeting:
- Confluence: Marketplace Listing Checklist (linked above)
- Jira: PRT-342 (billing automation)
- Infra tickets: infra-534 (AWS packaging throttling), sec-210 (image scanner integration)

Notes-to-self: keep tone collaborative, highlight customers who want private offer (helps escalate). Ask Liam for warm intro to AWS finance contact if possible. Close loop on marketing assets w/ comms and product by Nov 6.

Unresolved questions to surface in sync:
- Who owns post-listing support for marketplace-bought customers (support routing & SLAs)?
- Do we need to update pricing model for marketplace listing (per-unit vs reserved)? get pricing PM input.

End of notes. Will iterate and trim before sending agenda invite.
